name: Kangen no Mamiya ~Tsurupeta Loli Musume Boukenki~
original_name: 還元淫獣の魔宮 ～つるぺたロリ娘冒険記～
source:
Liz, who is a beginner adventurer, coincidentally found a treasure map of a ruin.
However, it is a dangerous place full of monsters.
But she never gives up for the treasure and decides to go in.
